AckDelivery.description: Input for acknowledging a successfully processed delivery.

AddMember.description: Input for adding one agent to a channel.

Agent.description: An addressable participant in the fleet.

ArmInvocation.description: Input for the write-ahead fence immediately before effectful dispatch.

BlockDelivery.description: Input for parking an ambiguously executed delivery under its active lease.

BlockResolution.description: Operator decision for a blocked delivery.

BlockedDelivery.description: One unresolved blocked delivery and its immutable source message.

Channel.description: A durable conversation shared by a bounded set of agents.

ClaimBatch.description: A set of deliveries owned by one expiring lease token.

ClaimDeliveries.description: Input for atomically leasing work from an agent inbox.

CompleteInvocation.description: Input for atomically publishing one result and acknowledging its invocation.

CreateChannel.description: Input for creating a channel and its initial membership.

Delivery.description: One leased inbox entry and the immutable message it carries.

ErrorResponse.description: Stable JSON envelope returned for fleetd domain errors.

ExecutionCertainty.description: What fleetd can prove about an invocation's external execution.

Invocation.description: One durable managed attempt reserved together with its inbox lease.

InvocationBatch.description: A batch of delivery attempts atomically leased and durably reserved.

InvocationCompletion.description: Durable result of completing one managed invocation.

InvocationState.description: Durable lifecycle state for one managed delivery attempt.

IssuedCredential.description:
A newly issued credential. Its token is returned once and never persisted
in plaintext by fleetd.

Message.description: An immutable message envelope in the global event sequence.

MessagePage.description: A cursor-addressed page from a channel's message history.

RegisteredAgent.description: An agent registration and its one-time credential response.

ResolveDeliveryBlock.description: Input for resolving one exact blocked-delivery record.

RetryDelivery.description: Input for releasing a failed delivery for a later attempt.

SendMessage.description:
Authenticated input for sending a message. The server supplies `sender_id`
from the bound agent credential.
